mapper.select: select id from ipe_ops.ops_user order by id
select role_code from ipe_ops.iam_user_role where user_id = #{userId} order by role_code
select distinct p.permission from ipe_ops.iam_role_permission p join ipe_ops.iam_user_role ur on ur.role_code = p.role_code where ur.user_id = #{userId} order by p.permission
select station_id from ipe_ops.iam_user_station where user_id = #{userId} order by station_id
select code, name from ipe_ops.iam_role order by code
select permission from ipe_ops.iam_role_permission where role_code = #{roleCode} order by permission
mapper.update: update ipe_ops.ops_user set auth_version = auth_version + 1 where id in (select user_id from ipe_ops.iam_user_role where role_code = #{roleCode})
mapper.select: select count(*) from ipe_ops.ops_user where username = #{username}
mapper.insert: insert into ipe_ops.ops_user (username, password_hash, enabled, all_stations, created_at) values (#{user.username}, #{user.passwordHash}, #{user.enabled}, #{allStations}, #{user.createdAt})
mapper.update: update ipe_ops.ops_user set enabled = #{enabled}, all_stations = #{allStations}, auth_version = auth_version + 1 where id = #{id}
update ipe_ops.ops_user set password_hash = #{passwordHash} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select exists (select 1 from ipe_ops.station where id = #{stationId})
